release_change.objective_exposure: 62/62 numbered objectives have at least one standard MCQ exposure

workflow: Run the 16-question diagnostic once if no baseline exists.
Study the lowest diagnostic domain with retrieval-before-reveal cards.
Use Exam + Stretch as the default standard-practice filter.
Commit confidence before answering; prioritize high-confidence misses for repair.
Review why all four options win or lose on every released standard question.
Use Bellringers separately as non-exam-representative integrative drills.
Re-test later rather than immediately repeating the same set.

question_bank_expansion_target.next_bias: After released-state confirmation, use the executable Batch 022 planner slate while selecting materially new scenario families and thin concepts.
question_bank_expansion_target.originality_rule: Questions are authored from public scope/primary standards and audited knowledge, never from exam dumps, live-item recollections, leaked banks, or commercial-question wording/templates.

deployment.activation_status: v1.19 is a promotion candidate only. Batch 021 passed exact candidate-inclusive main validation and public candidate-isolation checks, but the released-state promotion plus post-merge main audit and live Pages fingerprint must pass before v1.19 is called publicly released.

precision_boundary: The proposed CISSP Atlas v1.19 corpus contains 399 standard scenario questions, 1 Bellringer, 400 total bank records, and 540 semantically reviewed learner-facing item IDs with zero known keyed-answer reversals and no known remaining material factual error. Batch 021 passed exact released+candidate main audit 33023723634 with zero originality warnings and every CISSP gate, while Pages run 33023723631 independently proved the public v1.18 artifact excluded all unreleased candidate URLs. Explicit enriched-subtopic exposure measured 300/344 in the candidate-inclusive audit. GitHub did not register the declared pull_request workflow for PR #80; that limitation is recorded rather than hidden. Public v1.18.0 remains the last verified deployment until the v1.19 release state and live fingerprint pass. This resource remains unofficial and does not guarantee passing the live adaptive CISSP exam.
known_non_blocking_limitations: Browser-local progress does not sync across devices unless exported manually.
The diagnostic is intentionally a routing signal, not an exam-readiness prediction.
Blueprint subtopic labels are paraphrased; the ISC2 source remains authoritative for exact wording.

Legacy Q-001..Q-056 predate explicit enriched subtopic tags, so enriched-subtopic exposure measures explicit metadata coverage rather than proving that an untagged concept has never appeared in practice.
Question difficulty is an authoring scale until sufficient real learner-response data exists for empirical calibration.
GitHub did not register the declared pull_request Actions event for Batch 021 PR #80; exact main and Pages compensating evidence is recorded instead.
